{"title":"With Sam","text":"You ask Sam where they're from, and they say \"Lagos,\" and then \"the Ring,\" as if those are two different places, which they are. \"Mainland first,\" Sam says. \"Then the yard agency put me up on a refit, and I stayed up on one contract after another. Nine years. You live in a bunkroom that belongs to the contract. When it ends, you go down on the next spaceplane, unless you find another.\"","labels":["Listen","Tell them about where you came from"],"opens":["Sam is checking a weld seam on the galley rail with a thumbnail, and frowns at it. \"Whoever did that was paid by the metre,\" Sam says. \"On the Ring you're paid by the job, and the job's inspected, and if it fails you do it again for nothing. You learn to do it once.\"","Sam sets their mug down on the galley table and watches it with a professional eye. \"Half a g,\" Sam says. \"That's the rim on Lagos Ring. Things fall slower.
